direction_line: Write your answer to the prompts below.
prompt: You are meeting a classmate for the first time. Write five questions you would ask him/her and then five answers he/she would give you. Include at least four **-ar** verbs in present tense.
Imagine you are helping a classmate to find five locations on campus. Write five sentences describing how he/she can get to those places. Include at least four **-ar** verbs in present tense.

Write a paragraph about a typical day on campus. Mention what time you get there, how you get to your classes, what you do on your free time, etc. Include at least four **-ar** verbs in present tense.

Write a short description of your favorite course. What day and time of the week does it start? Which subject matters are studied? How does the professor teach? Include at least four **-ar** verbs in present tense.
Write five sentences describing what your teacher and classmates do on a typical day of class. Include at least four **-ar** verbs in present tense.
